title: Serial finite diagnostics do not establish cell lifetime
statement: The producer reports64 same-history retargetings with24h propagated holds,2110 probes,446 pulses,744.5s active teaching,1.0952ohm worst held branch error and.1894% exact operator error. Introduced thermal states are carried forward, not reset. Twelve blocked-cell and twelve low-threshold cases are rejected; the latter overdrive modeled coils and are not safe physical recovery evidence. Producer report/ZIP remain uncollected and Capital reruns none.
